subject: Re: Joint StratusWave x Redwood - scheduling a split-session demo
messages:
From: Patrick Hayes <patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + joint demo coordination

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. StratusWave (we're the SI coordinating AWS + GCP integrations) would like to run a joint marketplace/co-sell demo with Redwood for a prospect that spans APAC and EMEA/NA stakeholders. Primary asks:

- 45–60 minute combined session that shows Redwood Dedicated + marketplace listing flow (quick ops + pricing Q&A).
- An optional 20–30 minute technical break-out for our SI engineers to validate env/ops.

Constraint: our APAC team is mostly available in the morning SGT (9:00–11:00) and the EMEA buyers prefer late afternoons CET. NA stakeholders are flexible but can't do very early mornings PST.

We were thinking the week of Mar 22 or Mar 29 — can you propose a schedule that lets us serve both timezones without forcing a 4-hour block?

Attaching a short opportunity summary.

Thanks,
Patrick Hayes
Sr. Alliances Manager — StratusWave Systems
patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com

Attachment: SW_Opportunity_Pulse.pdf (summary, 1 page)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Hayes <patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + joint demo coordination

Patrick — thanks for the context and the summary. Great opportunity. A couple of ideas to avoid one long meeting while still covering both GTM and technical checks:

Proposal (staggered "time-slice" approach):
- Session A (30 min) — APAC-friendly technical deep-dive hosted by Alex + StratusWave engineers (concise ops + infra Q&A). Prefer 09:30–10:00 SGT.
- Session B (45 min) — EMEA + NA exec + GTM run-through: 16:00 CET / 10:00 ET — product demo, marketplace listing flow, pricing discussion.
- Fallback: Record both sessions, provide a 30-minute async Q&A window (Slack thread or shared doc) and an optional follow-up office hours for hands-on tenant access.

I'll loop in our partner lead (Vanessa) and marketplace engineer (Karthik) to confirm resources. Tessa, can you prepare a provisional invite and an .ics we can send to StratusWave? Attaching a draft calendar and a mutual action plan (v0.1) to iterate.

If APAC absolutely needs a later slot we can flip the order but prefer to keep the APAC technical slot as the lighter session (30 min) so engineers aren't on for full GTM.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_proposed_calendar.ics, mutual_action_plan_v0.1.pdf

From: Patrick Hayes <patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Rao <nina.rao@stratuswave.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro + joint demo coordination

Sergio — appreciate the clear proposal. Two quick notes from the SI side:

1) APAC engineers are traveling early that week and actually prefer an afternoon SGT slot (14:00–15:00 SGT) to be fully present.
2) Would prefer we do two shorter sessions on the same day rather than staggered multi-day: 30 min APAC tech + 30 min NA/EMEA GTM. That helps keep momentum.

Can Redwood provide a technical lead for both slots? Also, is it possible to loop in an AWS marketplace rep (we have a contact in Partner Ops) for the GTM session? If week of Mar 29 is easier for your team, we can move the whole plan.

Thanks — I'll confirm internal attendee list once Nina finalizes travel.

—Patrick

Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Hayes <patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + joint demo coordination — logistics + next steps

Patrick — thanks for the heads-up. We can do the two-short-sessions plan on the same day. Quick roles & next steps: 

- Alex: own technical facilitation for both sessions (will bring infra checklist and access token for demo tenant).
- Karthik: I'll hand the marketplace checklist / listing steps to you; please draft the one-pager needed for AWS Partner Ops.
- Tessa: will send calendar invites (two 30-min events) and include a shared Google doc for async Q&A. Also attaching the demo ops checklist we use for co-sell runbooks.

Action items for StratusWave: confirm final attendee list and preferred day (Mar 29 preferred by us but we can do Mar 24 if that works better for your APAC travel). Also indicate whether an AWS Partner Ops contact should be invited (we can handle the intro).

I'll also confirm that Redwood can provide an engineer for both slots — Alex, can you confirm?

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-ops-checklist.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Hayes <patrick.hayes@stratuswave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + joint demo coordination — logisitics confirmation

Hi Patrick — copy that. I can run both sessions (30 min APAC tech slot + 30 min NA/EMEA GTM).

Quick notes:
- I'll bring a short ops checklist and a live tenant with a pre-provisioned Dedicated instance to demo KV cache and routing failover.
- Please share any customer-specific prompts or compliance asks ahead of time.
- Tessa: please add me as a presenter on the invites and include dial-in + recording enabled.

Looking forward — Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
